# Cyber Strix — FTC Team 31022

> Student-led FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team from Mountain House, CA.

## Key facts

- Official name: Cyber Strix (FTC Team 31022)
- Location: Mountain House, California, United States
- Program: FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC)
- Award: 2nd Place Finalist Alliance at the 2026 North East League Tournament (FTC Qualifier 4)
- Outreach: 150+ students reached through STEM outreach, including an online STEM exchange with around 80 students in Gadag, India
- Focus: Competitive robotics, CAD, programming, leadership, camps, and community STEM programs
- Contact: cyberstrix31022@gmail.com
- Meeting times: Monday–Friday, 7:00–9:30 PM
